name: Spinal Pial Arteriovenous Fistula

criteria.description: Definitive visualization of abnormal arteriovenous shunting on spinal angiography
Presence of progressive myelopathy symptoms such as motor weakness and sensory deficits
Exclusion of other spinal vascular malformations such as dural arteriovenous fistulas

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive myelopathy symptoms combined with angiographic confirmation of spinal pial arteriovenous fistula
diagnosticCriteria.notes: MRI may suggest vascular malformation but spinal angiography is gold standard for diagnosis

searchTerms: gradual stiffness and weakness in legs

pathognomonic.symptomName: Spinal cord vascular bruit detected on auscultation
searchTerms: spinal cord blood vessel noise heard with stethoscope

common.symptomName: Sensory disturbances including numbness and paresthesia
searchTerms: sensory disturbances like pins and needles
difficulty walking due to leg weakness

common.symptomName: Back pain localized to affected spinal segment

rare.symptomName: Sudden onset paraplegia due to hemorrhage
searchTerms: sudden leg paralysis from spinal bleeding

rare.symptomName: Spinal cord edema visible clinically as swelling

imaging: Spinal digital subtraction angiography showing direct arteriovenous shunting
MRI demonstrating spinal cord edema and flow voids
MR angiography revealing abnormal vascular structures in the spinal cord
other: Electrophysiological studies showing impaired spinal cord conduction

distinguishingFeatures: Fistula located in dura mater rather than pial surface
Typically presents with more insidious onset
No direct arteriovenous shunting on angiography

redFlags: Sudden onset paraplegia or neurological deterioration
Signs of spinal cord hemorrhage or infarction
references: Jellema K, Tijssen CC, van Gijn J. Spinal dural arteriovenous fistulas: a congestive myelopathy that initially mimics a peripheral nerve disorder. Brain. 2006.
Krings T, Geibprasert S. Spinal dural arteriovenous fistulas. AJNR Am J Neuroradiol. 2009.
Hurst RW, Grossman RG. Spinal arteriovenous malformations and fistulas. Neurosurg Clin N Am. 1997.
